name: boxadm-mcp
description: Box admin-log analytics for Claude Code: external-sharing visibility from Box's enterprise event log (admin_logs) — who shares a lot with the outside, which files get accessed from outside, and a one-shot daily_brief health check. Read-only; never revokes shares, deletes files, or mutates anything. In oauth mode (BOX_AUTH_MODE=oauth) it needs a local OAuth token cache file (default ~/.config/boxadm-mcp/token.json, created once by running `boxadm-mcp auth`) that the plugin's own settings cannot fully provision — the default ccg mode needs no such file, but does require BOX_ENTERPRISE_ID. Requires BOX_CLIENT_ID, BOX_CLIENT_SECRET, BOX_ENTERPRISE_ID (ccg mode), and BOX_ALLOWED_DOMAINS.
